technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Framework 6.0+ with Java 17+ as the base platform.
Implement BOM templates using Maven or Gradle for dynamic external library inclusion.
Leverage Spring Cloud Stream for multi-binder support in U8.
Use JUnit 5 and Spring Test for unit and integration testing.
Follow existing project structure and coding conventions for consistency.
assumptions: The development environment is already set up with Java 17+, Spring Framework 6.0+, and necessary build tools.
Access to the referenced JIRA and GitHub issues is available for context on U7 and U8.
Existing test infrastructure and CI pipelines are in place and functional.
Documentation will be written in Markdown format and integrated into the project wiki or docs folder.
All SPI implementations (Lattice, CC, YARN) have existing interfaces and base classes available.
